title: Identify the delivery
action: Confirm the service, site, tenant/data scope, environment and work package.
expected: Scope and exclusions match the change request.
stop: Stop if the actual target or owner differs.

title: Freeze the engineering input
action: Resolve the HLD/LLD revision, drawings, schedules, exact tuple, approved configuration artifacts and hashes.
expected: One controlled build baseline is identified.
stop: Do not substitute moving latest versions or missing configuration.

title: Confirm authority and safety
action: Name executors, reviewer, stop/escalation authority, change window and allowed physical or intrusive-test scope.
expected: Required permissions and site safety releases apply to this action.
stop: No authorization or unsafe conditions: do not start.
evidence: Actual change/test decision and safety scope.

title: Prove access and recovery
action: Verify approved management path, protected credential custody, independent recovery access and data-safe recovery method.
expected: Recovery is usable for the failure this change can cause.
stop: Do not change the only working access path without the accepted recovery arrangement.

title: Review competing work
action: Check current owners, native tasks, locks, incidents and relevant resource/policy revisions.
expected: Single authoritative writer; no unresolved late task or stale approval.
stop: Pause and reconcile conflicts rather than overriding them.

title: Issue ready-to-execute record
action: Reviewer accepts the bounded MOP; record conditions and expiry.
expected: Execution may proceed only inside the issued scope.
stop: A kit checklist completion is not the authority decision.

title: Verify staged inventory
action: Reconcile received hardware/software/entitlements against the accepted BOM and trusted source.
expected: Components and firmware/driver tuple are accounted for.
stop: Quarantine mismatched or unverified items; retain custody evidence.

title: Accept physical installation
action: Qualified personnel complete approved manufacturer/facility installation and record links, racks, power and failure groups.
expected: Physical topology matches the released design.
stop: Do not improvise electrical, lifting or restricted facility procedures.

title: Establish bootstrap trust
action: Use the supported restricted console/OOB process and controlled temporary identity; provide accepted minimum time/name/trust.
expected: Privileged access is restricted and recoverable without tenant routing.
stop: Do not enable broad workload management reachability to finish bootstrap.
evidence: Bootstrap access, dependency and temporary-grant record.

title: Commission transport
action: Apply the accepted native configuration through the authoritative tool; verify neighbors, allowed routes, MTU and attachment membership.
expected: Observed underlay/fabric matches the selected design.
stop: Unexpected route import or bypass: stop, isolate affected scope and follow supported recovery.
evidence: Native configuration, routing and path observations.

title: Verify the failure boundary
action: Run only approved link/management fault observations with restoration procedures.
expected: Required access and enforcement survive as specified; interruption measured.
stop: No unapproved fault injection; do not treat denied traffic as proof of availability.
evidence: Fault scope, observations and restoration receipt.

title: Release G1 scope
action: Handover actual configuration, inventory, recovery copy, telemetry, capacity and limitations.
expected: Dependent platform work consumes accepted foundation capacity.
stop: Open mandatory foundation issue blocks affected consumption.

title: Confirm native support
action: Resolve cluster, manager, Flow, provider/API and hardware compatibility and enabled feature scope.
expected: Every needed operation has support evidence or an accepted alternative.
stop: A v2 resource name or provider availability is not full support.

title: Install under native ownership
action: Execute the approved vendor installation/lifecycle artifact with the protected management path.
expected: Native cluster and control services are healthy at the recorded versions.
stop: Use supported recovery on failure; never create a competing configuration owner.

title: Establish eligible pools
action: Configure approved host/zone/co-residency eligibility, storage/controller membership, templates and protection integration.
expected: Placement and restart constraints cover actual shared dependencies.
stop: Do not treat separate guest networks as physical isolation.

title: Commission virtual network capability
action: Prepare platform transport and isolated external handoff capacity; verify supported gateway/no-NAT/NAT choice and policy ownership.
expected: Independent domain routing and baseline controls precede endpoints.
stop: Shared connected external paths remain ineligible until isolation is proven.
evidence: Native handoff, route and policy observations.

title: Create authorized disposable fixture
action: Under restricted test permission, realize the WD logical roles with site allocations and current mandatory policy.
expected: Fixture ownership is stable; partial resources remain denied.
stop: Do not use documentation addresses as actual allocations or introduce production data.

title: Qualify and hand over
action: Observe relevant W14/CT outcomes, failure and restore; record actual resource create/update/adopt/delete handling.
expected: Accepted capability scope and limitations available for G2.
stop: Unrun or failed mandatory observation remains open.
evidence: Qualification report, native IDs and G2 scope decision.

title: Confirm routing-mode compatibility
action: Validate exact Tier-1/upstream context, parent Tier-0/VRF and HA mode against installed-release documentation and KIT-TN-01.
expected: Selected modes and service functions are supported together.
stop: Do not change a live parent mode merely to satisfy this checklist; require a separate impact-reviewed change.

title: Commission compute/storage management
action: Execute approved native vCenter/ESXi and storage installation, eligible pools, image/boot and management configuration.
expected: Actual placements and data dependencies match the LLD.
stop: Unsupported tuple or hidden shared management boundary blocks service acceptance.

title: Commission NSX transport and edge
action: Establish approved managers, transport nodes/zones, Edge capacity, uplinks and isolated upstream contexts.
expected: Actual distributed and centralized routing roles are identifiable.
stop: No common unrestricted native route table substitutes for the security boundary.

title: Protect mandatory endpoint and edge policy
action: Apply provider-owned groups, policy hierarchy and separately authorized ZIP relationships before workload connection.
expected: Same-host and cross-host controls cannot be widened by tenant mutation.
stop: Unexpected permissive default or override path keeps resources isolated.

title: Run restricted fixture and faults
action: Build the accepted disposable domains/VMs/disks; observe native route propagation, return context, HA/restart and protection.
expected: Observed outcomes support the offered service and actual failure scope.
stop: No unsupported HA or live-migration promise; stop unsafe fault execution.
evidence: Qualified test observations and recovery receipts.

title: Release scoped capability
action: Record vSphere/NSX ownership, provider lifecycle coverage, actual limits, limitations and evidence.
expected: G2 considers a concrete service/tuple rather than product names.
stop: Missing exact evidence prevents qualification.

title: Resolve selected services and backend
action: Record Keystone, Nova/Placement, Neutron backend, Glance/Cinder and all offered data/trust/protection services.
expected: No unsupported feature is inferred from generic OpenStack naming.
stop: Distribution or backend uncertainty blocks affected design.

title: Install using supported lifecycle tooling
action: Deploy the approved controllers/databases/messaging, compute and backend infrastructure under native ownership.
expected: Control/data dependencies and quorum are observed.
stop: Do not manage Neutron-owned OVN objects through a competing raw writer.

title: Enforce placement and data boundaries
action: Configure actual scheduler/aggregate/trait eligibility, volume backend classes and image/key controls.
expected: Tenant, zone and restart/restore constraints are effective.
stop: Labels without enforced placement do not satisfy isolation.

title: Protect network mutation authority
action: Implement provider ownership of base mandatory groups, port security, address pairs, routers and external attachments through the supported role model.
expected: Tenant permissions cannot attach an additive allow or disable required protection.
stop: Unbounded tenant editing is not base-service qualification.
evidence: API role tests and effective policy review.

title: Verify domain and service paths
action: Build restricted distinct domains and handoffs; observe distributed routes, gateways, default egress normalization, metadata/boot services and replies.
expected: Approved services work; connected/provider/floating-address shortcuts do not bypass controls.
stop: Avoid blanket deny that hides broken initialization or IPv6 operation.
evidence: Positive/negative path and native configuration evidence.

title: Qualify lifecycle and recovery
action: Observe supported create/update/adopt/delete, task cleanup, gateway/host failure, Cinder isolation and restore.
expected: Concrete tuple/service accepted or explicitly limited at G2.
stop: Unknown residual ports/routes/grants remain defects.

title: Create owned security capacity
action: Use the selected supported edge mechanism to instantiate isolated contexts/handoffs and separately protected management.
expected: Only permitted domains and routes belong to each context.
stop: Do not import unrelated tenant routes or expose admin interfaces on the consumption path.

title: Establish forward/reply paths
action: Configure accepted prefix and source policy, native gateway handoffs and service-side origin-specific replies.
expected: No connected, neighbour, NAT or alternate default path bypasses enforcement.
stop: Wrong or missing reply path remains unavailable rather than being masked by a broad route.

title: Publish named service consumption
action: Establish actual DNS/time/repository/log/identity endpoints, entitled operations and scoped initiators.
expected: Selected complete protocols work, including applicable DNS TCP/UDP behaviour.
stop: No broad provider subnet or administrative grant for a service binding.

title: Establish key and protection custody
action: Identify actual key-service client, capture API, data mover, protected copies, catalogue and held-data obligations.
expected: Tenant workloads do not inherit platform capture or key-destruction privileges.
stop: Missing key/catalogue recovery or independent-copy protection blocks the promise.
evidence: Role, copy lineage and recovery evidence.

title: Observe continuity and telemetry
action: Test approved service/edge outages and restore paths; verify origin attribution, buffering and actual surviving capacity.
expected: Security and service interruption both measured without fallback bypass.
stop: No unsafe fault or reliance on untested caches.

title: Accept service handoffs
action: Publish actual endpoints, permitted operations, owners, versions, limits and dependencies to downstream packages.
expected: P2/P3 offered capability is accepted before routine consumption.
stop: Incomplete mandatory service blocks dependent activation.

title: Choose the authorized path
action: Record restricted fixture permission or production prerequisites, exact service envelope and tenant owner.
expected: No production permission inferred from test authorization.
stop: Missing actual authorization stops the affected operation.

title: Reserve eligible resources
action: Allocate authoritative addresses, capacity, storage and attachment/security slots; establish tenant/domain scope.
expected: One owned reservation per resource; actual allocation recorded.
stop: No guessed values or use of excluded capacity.

title: Build denied topology
action: Create owned networks, gateways and baseline policy; coordinate paired edge routes/flows under the edge owner.
expected: No endpoint is exposed before mandatory enforcement.
stop: Unverified partial state remains disconnected/quarantined.

title: Create protected resources
action: Instantiate approved images/VMs/disks in eligible pools, then names, service identities, telemetry and protection.
expected: Actual attachments and client/admin boundaries match the LLD.
stop: Do not weaken placement or data custody to complete the request.

title: Observe applicable outcomes
action: Run scoped healthy-control, permitted/denied, resource/role, family and recovery observations.
expected: Actual results and artifacts recorded separately from expected outcomes.
stop: Unknown/failed mandatory results remain open, not passes.
evidence: IT test records and evidence index.

title: Complete initial readiness and activate
action: For production, verify G0/G1/G2/current tests, applicable G4 initial and valid operating authority; execute the approved exposure change and verify it.
expected: Only the accepted service scope becomes active.
stop: Failed live verification withdraws exposure without destroying data.
evidence: G3 decision, activation/post-check and operations confirmation.

title: Close or retain the fixture
action: Retire disposable test resources and reconcile reservations or formally accept the authorized continuing scope.
expected: No stale test permissions or orphan resource.
stop: Hold required evidence/data; do not blind-destroy shared resources.

title: Stabilize ownership
action: Pause competing changes and establish the actual writer, accepted tasks and incident restrictions.
expected: No second executor makes assumptions about task cancellation.
stop: Do not force-unlock until writer cessation is established by the approved recovery procedure.

title: Discover actual effects
action: Compare native resources, addressing, routes, data and state against the last confirmed step.
expected: Unknown outcomes become explicit owned findings.
stop: Do not replay create blindly or infer failure from a lost response.
evidence: Native IDs, task results and semantic difference.

title: Choose safe repair
action: Owner approves resume, supported rollback, forward repair or isolated operator intervention with data effects.
expected: Shared resources and newly written/held data are preserved.
stop: No generic compensation may destroy required data.
evidence: Recovery decision and bounded action plan.

title: Revalidate change basis
action: Replan affected scope when input, policy, state or authority changed; reconcile supported brownfield ownership/import.
expected: No stale plan or dual controller ownership.
stop: Import alone is neither compliance nor permission for replacement.

title: Execute and observe
action: Run approved scoped repair; retain containment until its authority releases it; verify impacted paths/data.
expected: Actual desired and realized state converges with supporting evidence.
stop: Unexpected effects stop further changes and trigger escalation.

title: Close and improve
action: Update as-built, source, defects, reservations, custody and runbook lessons.
expected: Unresolved effects remain visible and owned.
stop: Do not rewrite historical approval or hide retained exceptions.

title: Declare scope and writer authority
action: Identify failed/source/target systems, consistency requirements and permitted recovery action. Fence ambiguous writers by the accepted mechanism.
expected: One authorized write authority and protected evidence.
stop: Do not promote a second writer while ownership is unresolved.

title: Restore minimum dependencies
action: Recover approved administration, trust, name/time, keys/catalogue and source/configuration access.
expected: Recovery path does not depend solely on the failed platform.
stop: No plaintext, replacement-key or unrestricted privileged fallback.

title: Prepare isolated target
action: Establish eligible compute/data/network boundaries and required services under deny.
expected: Target supports required image/device/data/identity semantics.
stop: Unsupported conversion or co-residency blocks target use.

title: Transfer or restore consistent state
action: Use the approved platform/data tool through bounded authorized access; preserve copy lineage and measure actual data point.
expected: Useful consistent data is available and attributable.
stop: A completed job is not evidence of useful recovered data.

title: Verify and reconnect
action: Check application-owner data acceptance, required security/services and recovery timing before approved DNS/exposure cutover.
expected: Current authority accepts the defined recovered service.
stop: Failed verification keeps target isolated.
evidence: Measured RTO/RPO scope and activation record.

title: Fail back or retire source
action: Plan reverse synchronization after new writes; remove temporary routes/grants and reconcile retained copies.
expected: No stale writer, uncontrolled transition path or destroyed held key.
stop: Starting an old VM is not automatically safe rollback.

owner_role: Service operations and data disposition owners
title: Accept actual operations scope
action: Confirm owner/on-call/support, monitoring, accepted limits, patch/change process, custody and exercised recovery.
expected: Initial readiness supports the production promise.
stop: Missing actual owner or required restore evidence blocks initial acceptance.

owner_role: Service operations and data disposition owners
title: Plan retirement and preserve obligations
action: Identify dependent services/shared resources, held copies and keys; complete required export/backup before revoking required paths.
expected: Every remaining obligation has an accountable owner.
stop: Do not delete service access required to preserve held data.

owner_role: Service operations and data disposition owners
title: Withdraw live access
action: Under the relevant owner, remove exposures, ordinary flows, names, routes and grants; confirm session handling.
expected: No obsolete live connectivity/authority remains.
stop: Do not remove another tenant’s shared domain/service.

owner_role: Service operations and data disposition owners
title: Remove eligible resources
action: Delete only owned eligible workload/attachments; quarantine address reuse and preserve required history.
expected: Actual native state and inventory agree.
stop: Unknown asynchronous completion or reuse conflict remains blocked.

owner_role: Service operations and data disposition owners
title: Sanitize approved data/media
action: Use the approved media-appropriate process through qualified personnel; verify key/copy scope and held exceptions.
expected: Reuse is supported by actual sanitization evidence.
stop: Resource-record deletion is not proof of data destruction.

owner_role: Service operations and data disposition owners
title: Close and continue retained custody
action: Retain tombstone, evidence, obligations, access/key custody and future review/disposal dates.
expected: Live service retired; residual data remains explicitly controlled.
stop: Do not mark total destruction while copies remain.
evidence: Final service/data decision and continuing obligations.
